title: Another phone call from Buddy Rich
summary: Hinton notes that another call interrupted, with Buddy Rich calling him the first time, and returns to Chick Webb.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: Wait a minute, we got a phone call...

Just before we were interrupted by that telephone call, which is quite interesting; proves again that little psychological thing that you and I seem to have going all the time. People seem to be calling us. The other day Buddy Rich -

That's the first time Buddy Rich ever called me in my whole entire life. Here I was sitting with you, his dear friend, and he calls me from Florida. Here a guy calls me that I don't even know about a thing with Adolph Sutton another dear friend, a tremendous jazz musician. It's just unbelievable, here we're sitting doing the same type of thing. Now, to get back to what we were talking about, about Chick. If you want to continue with Chick it's all right. If not I'd like to ask you another question.
